meta.title: Lüzu Fortune Sticks - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Lüzu fortune sticks consist of one hundred sticks, said to be passed down by the immortal Lü Dongbin. Clues about any matter asked can be found in the stick text.
desc: Lüzu fortune sticks consist of one hundred sticks, said to be passed down by the immortal Lü Dongbin. Clues about any matter asked can be found in the stick text.
ui.1: Mentally recite "Lüzu Immortal, guide my way," state your question with a sincere heart, then draw a stick.
